baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two clauses join al-sama', munfatir, wa'duhu, and maf'ulan.
baseline_models.mechanism: An elevated enclosing surface loses integrity by opening, while the promise named in speech crosses into accomplished action. The second clause therefore classifies the rupture as execution rather than accident.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky-and-cover image supplies the enclosing upper surface whose integrity fails.
Opening, splitting, and visible fissure give munfatir its concrete breach mechanism.
A promise opened by speech supplies the prior commitment that is converted into event.
Occurrence and presence in time make the promised act a settled event rather than a free possibility.
Bringing an act about turns the promise from utterance into accomplished work.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states a damaged sky and then separately reassures that a promise is true.
changed_reading.after: The promised speech has become operative action, and the sky's breach is presented as its performed material result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kana wa'duhu maf'ulan follows the split sky as a temporal-executive predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise can function as an appointment, reinforced by the form-distant inventory of a prescribed counted term. Kana places it in occurrence and maf'ulan marks the appointment as having crossed its boundary into execution.

activation_trace.role: The appointed time-or-place image changes the promise from generic assurance into a scheduled encounter.
The non-dominant counted-term image sharpens the appointment as a bounded period that can expire.
Presence in time supplies the transition from a pending term to an occurring one.
Actual doing is the terminal state of the appointed promise.

changed_reading.before: His promise is an undated guarantee about a future rupture.
changed_reading.after: The rupture is the appointed term arriving: a counted commitment has passed from schedule into occurrence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Munfatir draws on a root inventory containing both fissure and origination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same focus root holds destructive opening and beginning. When the upper cover opens and the promise is made operative, the breach can mark a threshold into a newly originated condition rather than only the terminal loss of the old one.

activation_trace.role: The crack or opening supplies the destructive side of the transition.
Origination and beginning keep the opening live as an inaugural threshold.
The overhead cover is a boundary whose opening can separate one order from another.
Made action lets the threshold be an effected change of state, not a passive defect.

changed_reading.before: The split is only the terminal destruction of the sky.
changed_reading.after: The split is also an effected opening into a new condition, though the ayah does not specify that condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context packages a saying as something cast onto a recipient and made weight-bearing. The focus then names a promised utterance as performed action, so the sky rupture becomes the terminal effect of a transmitted, loaded word-event.

activation_trace.role: The speech-based promise is the focus-side utterance that will become effective.
Performed action supplies the conversion from utterance to realized effect.
The fissure is the concrete endpoint of the utterance-to-effect chain.
Casting until a thing lands supplies directed transfer toward a recipient.
Spoken expression identifies the transferred payload as utterance.
Burdening a load gives the saying consequential weight rather than mere volume.

structural_cues: 73:5 orders casting, recipient, saying, and heaviness in one construction.
73:18 places promise directly beside performed action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cast heavy saying and a promised act; I infer a payload-to-effect arrow ending in the sky's breach; alternatively, the heavy saying may train its recipient without causing the cosmic event.

changed_reading.before: The rupture fulfills a proposition that remains external to the surah's earlier speech event.
changed_reading.after: The surah's heavy saying models how promised speech carries operative weight until it lands as world-changing action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deliberate delay is explicitly small and is followed by repeated naming of a day. This turns the focus promise into a bounded appointment: postponement preserves rather than weakens its eventual performance.

activation_trace.role: The promise as appointed time supplies the schedule that delay approaches.
Occurrence in time marks the appointment's transition into presence.
Deliberation without haste establishes postponement as controlled timing.
Smallness bounds the postponement and blocks a reading of indefinite nonperformance.
A delimited span of time gives the delayed promise its named horizon.

structural_cues: 73:11 says wa-mahhilhum qalilan, binding delay to a small quantity.
The repeated day markers in 73:14 and 73:17 lead into kana wa'duhu maf'ulan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded delay, named day, and an appointed promise; I infer delay-to-deadline-to-execution; alternatively, the day references may locate scenes without defining a schedule.

changed_reading.before: Delay could make the promise sound remote or suspended.
changed_reading.after: Delay is a measured interval inside the promise, and the split sky marks the appointment reaching execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger is dispatched in an explicit analogy, disobedience follows, and accountability is enacted. This prior completed sequence functions as an executable precedent for the focus claim that the threatened promise is performed.

activation_trace.role: Threat and warning specify the adverse side of the promise now said to be performed.
Occurrence in time lets completed precedent support future certainty.
Actual doing is the focus-side state demonstrated by the precedent.
Repeated dispatch establishes the two cases connected by the analogy.
Departure from obedience supplies the triggering breach in the precedent case.
Being held to account for wrongdoing supplies the precedent's realized consequence.

structural_cues: 73:15 uses kama to compare the present messenger mission with the mission to Pharaoh.
73:16 compresses disobedience and seizure through consecutive fa clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit analogy and a completed disobedience-to-seizure chain; I infer that chain licenses the focus promise as repeatable execution; alternatively, it may serve only as a warning example.

changed_reading.before: Maf'ulan is an unsupported assertion of future certainty.
changed_reading.after: Maf'ulan carries procedural precedent: messenger, refusal, and enacted consequence have already formed the same kind of chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lower world first enters violent oscillation; elevated solid masses become loose accumulations and pour away. The focus then extends the same loss of cohesion upward, where the enclosing sky fissures. Together they form a bottom-to-top material cascade.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the upper boundary reached by the cascade.
Fissuring is the upper boundary's mode of losing cohesion.
Violent disturbance initiates material instability at ground level.
A raised solid aggregation supplies the stable mass that is about to change phase.
Accumulation into a mound converts coherent mountain into granular heap.
Pouring measured material supplies the heap's loss of fixed form and support.

structural_cues: 73:14 predicates successive states of earth and mountains in one scene.
73:18 returns to the upper cosmic boundary and predicates another failure of integrity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking, solid aggregation, granular accumulation, pouring, and upper fissure; I infer a lower-to-upper phase-transition arrow; alternatively, the scenes may be parallel signs with no physical propagation.

changed_reading.before: The split sky is an isolated spectacular sign.
changed_reading.after: The sky's fissure is the terminal upper stage of a world-wide de-cohesion already visible in earth and mountains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding day actively converts the newly young into the visibly old; the focus pronoun bihi then lets that same day exert a second transformation on the sky, converting enclosure into fissure. Biological time-compression and cosmic rupture become effects at different scales.

activation_trace.role: Splitting supplies the cosmic object's transformed state.
Occurrence in time ties the transformation to the promised temporal event.
A span of time supplies the nearest masculine antecedent and shared transformative medium.
Making a thing enter a condition establishes active state conversion.
The newly young supply the biological starting state most distant from age.
Gray hair supplies the abruptly imposed terminal age-state.

structural_cues: 73:17 makes yawman the subject of yaj'alu and places it immediately before 73:18.
The singular masculine pronoun in bihi can resume yawman across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one day, an explicit child-to-gray transformation, adjacency, and bihi; I infer one cross-scale transformer acting on child and sky; alternatively, bihi may resume the promised event more generally.

changed_reading.before: Bihi points vaguely to a catastrophe, and the gray children are a separate image.
changed_reading.after: The same day compresses a lifetime in children and breaks the cosmic cover, displaying one pressure across biological and cosmic scales.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question asks how protection can be made while concealment is practiced; the next ayah depicts the largest available cover as itself split. Human covering and attempted self-covering are answered by failure of the cosmic cover.

activation_trace.role: The sky as overhead cover supplies the macro-shelter that cannot remain intact.
The fissure makes the cover's protective failure visible.
Ward-off protection frames the immediately preceding question as a search for shelter.
Covering and concealment supply the human action reversed by the sky-cover's exposure.

structural_cues: Fa-kayfa tattaquna in kafartum immediately precedes al-sama'u munfatirun bihi.
The rhetorical question asks for a means of protection before the answer-image removes the upper cover.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, concealment, an overhead cover, and its fissure; I infer a rhetorical cover-to-failed-cover reversal, not an etymological identity; alternatively, kufr may remain purely moral with no image-link to the sky.

changed_reading.before: The sky rupture is only an external threat after a question about piety or protection.
changed_reading.after: The rupture answers the shelter question: concealment cannot secure anyone when the encompassing cover itself opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opening is followed immediately by volition and a traversable path. The cosmic breach can therefore function not only as collapse but as the warning-threshold that exposes a choice of route toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Opening and fissure supply a breach through a previously closed boundary.
Origination keeps the breach available as a threshold to a new orientation.
Will attached to a thing supplies agency at the threshold rather than compulsory movement.
An extended traversable road supplies the route made urgent by the warning-opening.

structural_cues: 73:19 immediately reclassifies the preceding material as a tadhkirah and then states fa-man sha'a.
The chosen path is directed ila rabbihi rather than left as undirected escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fissure, immediate reminder, volition, and path; I infer that the breach exposes a decision-threshold; alternatively, 73:19 may merely append exhortation after an unrelated warning.

changed_reading.before: The opened sky closes all horizons in terminal catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: As warning, the opening also exposes a still-voluntary route; destruction and decision-threshold coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus declares a promise performed, the context contrasts divine measuring with human inability to exhaustively count and twice opens an easier practicable amount. Performance is thus situated within measured agency rather than imagined as undifferentiated force.

activation_trace.role: The appointed promise supplies the event whose mode of enactment is being qualified.
Bringing action about is the focus-side execution later viewed through measure.
Planning by measure and consideration supplies calibrated agency.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning marks the human limit against which adjustment occurs.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the practicable adjustment that follows failed counting.

structural_cues: 73:20 sets Allah's measurement of night and day against the community's inability to enumerate it.
The command to read what is feasible is repeated after that acknowledged limit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies performed promise, divine measurement, failed human reckoning, and repeated ease; I infer that fulfillment belongs to calibrated agency; alternatively, 73:20 may regulate worship without qualifying the catastrophic promise.

changed_reading.before: Maf'ulan suggests only irresistible execution without texture or measure.
changed_reading.after: The promise remains inevitable, but its performance belongs to an agency elsewhere shown measuring conditions and opening practicable response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant split mappings of sama' toward visible mark and narrow opening, then aligns them with witness and knowledge branches. It remains anchored in the focus sky and munfatir fissure, but downstream prose should call it an exploratory mark-reading rather than replace the ordinary sky lexeme.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The visible sky at word 1 is fissured at word 2 and the promise is declared performed.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the changed sky carry evidentiary legibility.
A narrow opening supplies the form of the inscribed mark.
Visible fissure anchors the marked opening in the actual focus predicate.
A witnessing sign makes visible alteration function as testimony.
An identifying trace that guides recognition makes the fissure readable as evidence of fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: The sky is merely the object damaged by fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: Its fissure is also a visible identifying mark that witnesses the promise's passage into action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries material images from reward and forgiveness backward toward a cosmic fracture. The reading remains anchored in the focus's broken overhead cover and in explicit post-focus branches for mending and protective covering; render it as an imagistic response pattern, not as a claim that ajr or ghafr lexically gloss the sky's repair here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The overhead sky-cover is split open in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the damaged protective surface.
The split supplies the fracture to which later repair images respond.
Mending a crooked break supplies a reparative answer to rupture.
A preserving cover supplies protection after the image of a failed cover.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic cover's fracture is terminal and leaves no response-image.
changed_reading.after: The closing context places mending and preserving cover after fracture, allowing warning and repair to remain in the same imagistic field.

strongest_changes: The heavy saying turns promise-to-action into a transmitted payload chain rather than a bare prediction.
The preceding day transforms children and sky across biological and cosmic scales, giving bihi a concrete antecedent.
Earthquake, solid mountain, granular mound, pouring, and sky fissure form a coherent vertical loss-of-cohesion sequence.
Bounded delay and the Pharaoh precedent make fulfillment both scheduled and procedurally demonstrated.
Post-focus measurement and ease qualify enactment, while repair and covering remain live only as contained exploratory imagery.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's compact syntax supports several mechanisms at once: speech becoming deed, appointment becoming present, matter losing cohesion, and an opening that can be both terminal breach and threshold. The packet's split mappings added readable-mark and counted-term possibilities without displacing the dominant roots.
remaining_uncertainties: Bihi most readily resumes the preceding day, but it can still denote the promised event more generally.
The earth-to-sky cascade may be causal propagation or a sequence of parallel signs.
The marked-fissure and counted-term readings depend partly on non-dominant mappings and require explicit qualification.
The measured-ease material in 73:20 may qualify the same agency of fulfillment or may be a separate pastoral coda.
